title: 第十三章 袭杀荒军第十四章 武威段氏
content_zh:
“练！”
经过短暂的犹豫，白宣就下定了决心。
相比于前面三个听都没听过的阵法，很显然，这个阵法对白宣来说更有用。
以后，还可以升级成为九曲黄河阵。
然后再从九曲黄河阵，升级成陷仙剑的阵法。
至于两百七十道阵印比较多这对白宣来说，不是问题。
反正，他有的是时间。
想到此处，白宣深吸一口气，退出诛仙阵图的世界，再睁开眼来，就回到了驿站房间之中。
白宣看着四周，再看自己面前的诛仙阵图，有种恍然如梦的错觉，看着附在阵图上许世安的透明魂魄，道：“小世安啊，你也是有好待遇了，有诛仙阵图在，你这魂魄就是放上几千年也散不掉，哥慢慢帮你复活啊。”
许世安的魂魄有些茫然地看着白宣，现在的他还没有恢复意识。
“好了，不和你说了，哥要修炼了。”
白宣拍了拍许世安的魂魄，沉下心来，静心参悟天地之道，凝聚阵印。
精神放空，一缕缕的神念涌动，用画符一般的方法，尝试在虚空当中勾画出陷仙阵印，开启自己的阵法之路。
只是凝聚阵印远比白宣想的还要复杂。
阵纹，只需要将法力打出去就好。
然而阵印，却要按照特定的方式将力量分布在每一道阵纹上。
分布如果出现错误，整个阵印就错了。
本质上就和画符一样。
来吧，我人生当中的第一道阵印。
白宣沉浸在修炼之中，凝聚元气，按照特有的轨迹修炼。

白宣自信满满，雄姿英发。
然后，一次失败、两次失败、三次失败，四次失败……
时间一点一点的流逝，外边天空都渐渐发亮。
白宣坐在位子上，一夜未睡，眼睛几乎要发出绿光。
失败，失败。
只有失败。
他竟然没有成功！
这辈子第一次修炼这么缓慢。
以往学功法，只要他想学，他都能立刻学会。
许世安花费数月乃至数年才能修炼成功的武功，他一眼就能学会。
可这个阵道，怎么这么难，难道我阵道上的天赋不够强大不成？
却是白宣不知，诛仙四剑分别代表着诛、戮、陷、绝四种剑意。
诛、戮、绝都是正面的攻击手段。
诛仙光明正大，戮仙杀气最盛，绝仙最是无情。
唯陷例外。
并非单纯以强大的力量正面攻击，而是以柔克刚，如太极，扳、粘等柔劲。
无形之中，编织出一张大网，将对方所有力量消弭，活活困杀。
本就是四大阵道之中最难的一种。
九曲黄河阵以此为根基延伸，黄河九曲，消弭万物，修行同样不易。
需知，两百七十道阵印，已然属于高级灵阵。

位列阵法第四等级。
而白宣才是第一等级的阵法师啊。
白宣懊恼，最后拍了拍自己的脸，让自己强行冷静下来，打算今天找机会再请教一下李道衍或者许玉华。
这凝聚阵印是不是有什么诀窍。
感叹着，白宣忽然感应到数里之外，一股若有若无的杀气涌动。
content_en:
"Practice!"
After a brief hesitation, Bai Xuan made up his mind.
Compared to the previous three formations that he had never heard of before, it was obvious that this formation was more useful to Bai Xuan.
In the future, it can be upgraded to the Jiuqu Yellow River Formation.
Then it was upgraded from the Nine-Bend Yellow River Formation to the Formation of the Immortal Sword Trap.
As for the relatively large number of two hundred and seventy formation seals, it is not a problem for Bai Xuan.
Anyway, he has plenty of time.
Thinking of this, Bai Xuan took a deep breath, exited the world of Zhuxian Formation, opened his eyes again, and returned to the inn room.
Bai Xuan looked around, then looked at the Zhuxian Formation in front of him, feeling as if he was in a dream. Looking at Xu Shian's transparent soul attached to the formation, he said: "Xiao Shi'an, you are in good hands. With the Zhuxian Formation here, your soul will not be dissipated even if it is left for thousands of years. I will slowly help you resurrect."
Xu Shian's soul looked at Bai Xuan blankly, and he had not yet regained consciousness.
"Okay, I won't tell you anymore, I'm going to practice."
Bai Xuan patted Xu Shian's soul, calmed down, meditated on the way of heaven and earth, and condensed the formation seal.
With his mind empty, wisps of spiritual thoughts surged, and he used the method of drawing talismans to try to draw the Immortal Trap Formation Seal in the void to start his own formation path.
It's just that the condensed formation seal is far more complicated than Bai Xuan thought.
For the formation pattern, you just need to release the mana.
However, the formation seal must distribute power on each formation pattern in a specific way.
If there is an error in the distribution, the entire formation will be wrong.
It's essentially the same as a talisman.
Come on, the first formation seal in my life.
Bai Xuan immersed himself in cultivation, gathered his energy, and practiced according to his unique trajectory.
Bai Xuan is full of confidence and has a majestic appearance.
Then, one failure, two failures, three failures, four failures...
Time passed little by little, and the sky outside gradually became brighter.
Bai Xuan sat in his seat, having not slept all night, his eyes almost glowing green.
Failure, failure.
There is only failure.
He didn't succeed!
This is the first time in my life that I am practicing so slowly.
In the past, whenever he wanted to learn the exercises, he could learn them immediately.
It took Xu Shian months or even years to successfully practice the martial arts, but he could learn it at a glance.
But why is this formation so difficult? Is it because my talent in the formation is not strong enough?
But Bai Xuan didn't know that the four swords of Zhu Xian respectively represented the four sword intentions of killing, killing, trapping and exterminating.
Punishing, killing, and killing are all frontal means of attack.
Zhu Xian is fair and upright, Killing Immortal is the most murderous, and Jue Immortal is the most ruthless.
Exceptions are made.
It is not simply a frontal attack with strong force, but softness to overcome hardness, such as Tai Chi, pulling, sticking and other soft skills.
Invisibly, a big net is woven to eliminate all the opponent's power, trapping and killing them alive.
It is the most difficult one among the four major formations.
The Nine-Bend Yellow River Formation is based on this and extends. The nine bends of the Yellow River eliminate all things, and cultivation is equally difficult.
It should be noted that the two hundred and seventy formation seals are already high-level spiritual formations.
Ranked at the fourth level of the formation.
And Bai Xuan is the first-level formation master.
Bai Xuan was annoyed, and finally patted his face to force himself to calm down. He planned to find an opportunity to ask Li Daoyan or Xu Yuhua for advice today.
Is there any secret to this condensed formation seal?
Sighing, Bai Xuan suddenly sensed a vague murderous aura several miles away.
